topic: Quick tip: how to keep a medication list
headline: Keep a
subhead: 4 steps to a list that helps you.
intro: A current medication list helps your pharmacist and doctor give you the right advice. Here's how to make one.

points.title: List every medication
points.body: Include prescriptions, over-the-counter products, vitamins, creams and natural health products.
points.tip: Add the strength and how often you take it.

points.title: Note your allergies
points.body: Write down any allergies or side effects you've had, so they're easy to share at every visit.
points.tip: Include food and latex allergies too.

points.title: Update it after changes
points.body: Added, stopped or changed something? Update your list the same day so it stays accurate.
points.tip: Write the date each time you update it.

points.title: Keep it with you
points.body: Keep a copy in your wallet or a photo on your phone for appointments and emergencies.
points.tip: Share a copy with a family member.

cta_body: Ask if you're eligible for a MedsCheck review.
